# Third-party data in the classic maps

The files `*-nav.js` here are generated by `tools/maps/extract-nav.mjs` from:

1. **awpy navigation data** (heights, floors, place names, connections) — github.com/pnxenopoulos/awpy, commit a5434abc06, `awpy/data/nav/nav_info.csv`, `de_<map>.txt`, `awpy/data/map/map_data.json`. MIT licence, notice below.
2. **Radar overviews** sampled into the per-cell floor / wall / cover mask — github.com/boltgolt/boltobserv `src/maps/<map>/radar.png` and `meta.json5`.
   - Ancient and Anubis: MIT licence, Lexogrine (notice below).
   - Dust II, Mirage, Inferno, Nuke, Cache, Train: no licence file of their own; the boltobserv repository is **GPL-3.0**.

The map layouts themselves are Valve's designs (Counter-Strike: Global Offensive); the navigation meshes and overviews above are derived from Valve's game files.
